verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I'm so secure
You're here with me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You stay the same
Your love remains here in my heart

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
So close I believe
You're holding me now

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
In Your hands I belong
You'll never let me go

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You gave Your life
and Your endless love

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You set me free and show the way
Now I am found

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
All along You were beside me
even when I couldn't tell

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Through the years
You showed me more of You
more of You
